map.四套公式（均以 5 英尺 = 60 英寸为基准，超出部分按系数递增，单位 kg）: Four formulas (all based on 5 ft = 60 in, increasing by a coefficient per extra inch, in kg)
map.Devine：男 50 + 2.3×超出英寸，女 45.5 + 2.3×超出英寸: Devine: male 50 + 2.3×extra inches, female 45.5 + 2.3×extra inches; Hamwi: male 48 + 2.7×, female 45.5 + 2.2×; Miller: male 56.2 + 1.41×, female 53.1 + 1.41×; Robinson: male 52 + 1.9×, female 49 + 1.7×. in = height(cm) ÷ 2.54. Below 152.4 cm (5 ft) the formulas extrapolate unreliably, so no result is shown.
map.in = 175 ÷ 2.54 = 68.90，超出 8.90 英寸 ⇒ Dev: in = 175 ÷ 2.54 = 68.90, i.e. 8.90 inches over 5 ft ⇒ Devine = 50 + 2.3×8.90 = 70.5 kg; Hamwi = 48 + 2.7×8.90 = 72.0 kg; Miller = 56.2 + 1.41×8.90 = 68.7 kg; Robinson = 52 + 1.9×8.90 = 68.9 kg; the four-formula mean is about 70.0 kg.
map.四个公式该用哪个？: Which of the four formulas should I use?
map.临床给药与通气最常用 Devine；Hamwi 多用于营养评估，Miller 与: Devine is most used for clinical dosing and ventilation; Hamwi is common in nutritional assessment, while Miller and Robinson are later revisions. A 2–4 kg spread at the same height is normal; the key is to stay consistent within one setting and not mix them.
map.为什么身高低于 152 cm 不给结果？: Why is no result shown below 152 cm?
map.四套公式都以 5 英尺为基准做线性外推，低于基准时结果会明显偏低甚至为负，不能反: All four formulas extrapolate linearly from a 5 ft baseline; below it the results are markedly low or even negative and do not reflect physiological values, so use paediatric or dedicated formulas instead.
map.身高需 ≥ 152.4 cm（5 英尺）才能套用这些公式；低于该值请改用儿科或专: Height must be ≥ 152.4 cm (5 ft) for these formulas; below that use paediatric or dedicated formulas.
map.算法（Devine，按英寸）：身高换算英寸 hIn=身高cm/2.54；男 IB: Algorithm (Devine, inches): hIn = height(cm)/2.54; male IBW = 50 + 2.3×(hIn−60), female = 45.5 + 2.3×(hIn−60), already in kg (no lb conversion). Height must be > 0.
map.单位均为 kg；身高 < 152.4 cm（5 英尺）时公式外推不可靠，本页不给: All in kg; below 152.4 cm (5 feet) the formulas extrapolate unreliably, so this page gives no result
map.IBW 是给药、通气等临床计算基准，不是健康体重或胖瘦评判标准；四式结果本身就有: IBW is a clinical calculation basis for dosing, ventilation and similar uses, not a healthy-weight or body-fat judgment; the four formulas themselves differ by several kilograms.
map.算法（Devine，按英寸）：身高换算英寸 hIn=身高cm/2.54；男 IB: Method (Devine, by inches): height in inches hIn = height cm/2.54; male IBW = 50 + 2.3×(hIn−60), female IBW = 45.5 + 2.3×(hIn−60); the coefficients are already in kg (base 50 / 45.5 kg, plus 2.3 kg for each inch above 5 feet), so the result is in kg with no lb→kg conversion needed. Height ≥152.4 cm is required; below 5 feet no extrapolation.
map.不是健康评判，是临床计算基准（尤其给药、呼吸机）；肌肉量高者 IBW 偏低也正常: No, it is not a health judgment but a clinical calculation basis (especially for dosing and ventilators); a low IBW is normal in people with high muscle mass, and actual weight varies with body type.
map.肥胖患者剂量按 IBW 还是实际体重？: Should obese patients be dosed by IBW or actual body weight?
map.视药物：脂溶性/分布广的可能用校正体重，水溶/按 IBW 设计的用 IBW；须依: It depends on the drug: lipophilic agents with wide distribution may use adjusted body weight, while water-soluble agents or those designed around IBW use IBW; always follow the package insert and clinical judgment.
